user_prompt: 将场景变成明显的大雪天气，雪势较大，持续降雪，画面中清楚可见大量雪花和积雪倾向；保持道路、植被、建筑、相机运动和原有几何结构不变

revision_feedback.snow_intensity: Make the snowfall visibly heavier than a light flurry: many clearly visible snowflakes and a strong continuous snow atmosphere, while preserving source-grounded road geometry, objects, camera motion and cross-view identity.
revision_feedback.clip_tail: Inspect the true last frame and describe the closing action only when supported by the supplied evidence; report uncertainty rather than inventing unseen details.
